beijing/primary.A_sampling: up to 32 uniform indices across all legal A origins, fixed before inspecting forecast errors
beijing/primary.threshold_scope_limitation: median of these <=32 past windows, not full-A window population; this is an exploratory description

definitions.input: ROOT supplied finite past-only filled/A-standardized [B,L,C]; no future/targets
definitions.period_selection: A-only or pre-existing sampling metadata, ROOT must record provenance

stl_settings.numerical_variance_floor: float64 epsilon * max(1, variance(series)); degenerate ratios stay unavailable

definitions.volatility_std: mean across channels of population std along observed historical grid
definitions.cross_channel_lag_max_abs_corr: max |Pearson(x_i[lag:],x_j[:-lag])| over ordered i!=j and lag1..min(24,L-2), overlap separately centered
definitions.groups: A finite median; low<=median/high>median/unavailable; report all counts and errors including empty groups
definitions.interpretation: past descriptions only; no causality, significance, independent-generalization or predictive-sufficiency claim
